install_msg: Thank you for installing ModReload! Configure tracked modules with `[p]modreload add`. It's not meant to be installed and was hastily copied from [HotReload](https://c.csw.im/cswimr/SeaCogs/src/branch/main/hotreload).
name: ModReload
short: Automatically reinstall and reload tracked Python modules on change.
description: Watches local Python packages (non-cogs) and reinstalls/reloads them when files change.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store end user data.
